notes.title: Wave of Darkness Patch 1.80
notes.content:
Hi all!

The new Wave of Darkness patch is out, and we have spent a lot of time to tamper with several aspects of gameplay, namely, the spells. The spells are now completely "unstacked" which means you don't need to wait for casted spell to expire. In other words, you can cast as many spells as you like, as long as you have enough Faith to cast spells with.

Other than that, we have also fixed several annoying bugs, as well as some new features. For example, it is now possible to carry two-handed weapon while the secondary hand has an item in it.

We would also like to remind that Wave of Darkness [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/316370/discussions/0/496881136928392983/]supports Steam Controller[/url]! All you have to do is to find the template called "mUndays Wave of Darkness" and that's basically it.

Also, if you're new to Wave of Darkness, make sure to check the official [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=549988639]Beginner's Guide[/url]!

Here is the full changelog for Patch 1.80:

[list]
[*]change: protection spell effects should not be stackable anymore, only min/max values are used
[*]change: creature auras effects should not be stackable anymore, only min/max values are used
[*]change: poisonous plants auras effects should not be stackable anymore, only min/max values are used
[*]change: "creatures" to "Venomous Spiders" in "Warmongers" quest description
[*]change: darkened secondary hand item while using two handed weapons
[*]change: it is now possible to carry two handed weapon while secondary hand has item in it, it stays in secondary hand item slot but it is not used
[*]change: 3d model of secondary hand weapon/shield will not be rendered if primary hand has two-handed item in it
[*]fix: fixed light crash bug
[*]fix: added doors for central dungeon in Sidis Tarea
[*]fix: added quest check at these doors so that they cannot be opened without using Crown of Time, Crown of Decision, Crown of Change and Crown of Essence items on the pillars around the dungeon entrance
[*]change: Amulet of Time/Decision/Change/Essence items are now changed to Crown of Time/Decision/Change/Essence with corresponding icons
[*]change: critical bonus not applied to secondary hand items while carrying two handed weapon in primary hand
[*]change: armor, defense, attack, damage, resistance modifiers, ability modifiers not applied to secondary hand items while carrying two handed weapon in primary hand
[*]change: attack/defense/damage/armor vs creature type not applied to secondary hand items while carrying two handed weapon in primary hand
[*]fix: Cave of Winds smoke/cloud texture added
[*]fix: tooltips for the inventory bag names are now displayed correctly
[/list]

As usual, give us your [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/316370/discussions/0/598198173699356534/]suggestions and new great ideas[/url]!

Thank you!

Your,
Dreamatrix Team

notes.title: Wave of Darkness Patch 1.60
notes.content:
[h1]Wave of Darkness Patch 1.60[/h1]

Hi all!

We have published an another update which is somewhat a smaller patch, but our lead programmer spent a lot of time working on it.

It brings the following:

[list]
[*]Mouse wheel is now enabled to zoom the map in and out.
[*]Fixed an issue with Teleport Stones which rendered blank destinations. (Big thanks to ronald63108 for the report!)
[*]Added "You are here" tooltip when the map is opened, so the player's location is now much more visible.
[*]Added French and Hungarian translation for the tooltip.
[/list]

As always, please give us your feedback regarding the patches in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/316370/discussions/0/598198356164874999/]Patches thread[/url], as well as your [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/316370/discussions/0/598198173699356534/]Suggestions[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/316370/discussions/0/598198173699343906/]Bug and Crash reports[/url]!

Thank you!

Your,
Dreamatrix Team

notes.title: The new, HUGE Wave of Darkness update is LIVE + Release date!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Well, after four months of hard work and battles with all kind of murky villains during Early Access, we are proud to announce that Wave of Darkness is getting ready for the full release at 5th of November 2015!

During the Wave of Darkness Early Access, we have been astonished by the amount of good and positive vibrations among the community who wanted to help with great ideas, bug reports and, naturally, constructive criticism.

Majority of your suggestions, bug reports and some criticism resulted in five major patches and several smaller patches which helped Wave of Darkness to become a more stable, more robust, and ultimately a better RPG title. All in all, during Early Access development stage we have applied over 70 game fixes and over 15 new features; some bigger, some smaller. 

[h1]Now, about that massive new Wave of Darkness update. Here is what you will get:[/h1]

[list]
[*]added intro video
[*]added bunch of tooltips for character generation panels, character info panel, inventory, spellbook, maps panel, legendary items panel and quest log panel
[*]minimum number of inventory slots increased from 14 to 42 (see, we do listen to your suggestions ;-)

[*]added voiceover files for:
[list]
[*]Taras Ras Balinos (ship captain on docks)
[*]herbalist (on docks)
[*]Ubar Nevera (defense commander)
[*]Alitea Nevera (leader of rangers)
[*]Casir Ras Dianos (herbalist on south entrance to the city)
[*]Xocutus (blind librarian)
[*]Silvana Vordar (Xocutus' happy helper)
[*]Nilara Vordar (Nils' grand-grand-grand-...-grand-daughter)
[*]Llorena (Disciple of Veles priestess)
[*]Vinkl Minkel (opportunistic weapons dealer from Legends of Dawn)
[*]Lord Darius Nevera
[*]Lady Selina Vordar
[*]Baba Yarra (crazy old lady with chickens)
[*]Elniren (ranger)
[*]Sorin Amas Darelin (herbalist)
[*]Arun Bis Lorenar (soldier)
[*]Darien Palar (merchant from Cesanaar)
[*]Garo (caretaker's son)
[*]Smragor the Mighty (caretaker of Temple of Time)
[*]Telnir (cursed caretaker)
[*]Sileran Dain Vaturas (wizard in Mirna's house)
[*]Barnir (Lamar's brother, hermit)
[*]Lamar (priest in Nam Yorath)
[*]Lord Aturil Zetar (exiled leader)
[*]Theral Zetar (lord Zetar's son)
[*]Grummharal (ancient hero merged with Bezharal)
[*]Ralan (fisherman in village on the edge of desert)
[*]Morodok the Evil Shaman
[*]Tka'r (only rizar in the game)
[*]Saradok (leader of Snake Cult)
[*]Zoug (monster in castle brown-skull)
[/list]

[*]fixed bug with game crashing on alt+tab while in character generator or main menu
[*]fixed/changed/updated tons of NPC conversation texts (mostly changes regarding grammar, and some slight changes regarding quest objectives)
[*]fixed item generation bug when creating new characters (one where it was possible to get items such as weapons and armor with too high requirements, you were able to de-equip those items but were unable to equip them again)
[*]fixed 'Smash and Run' quest description in quest log panel
[*]fixed 'Dark Sisters' quest description in quest log panel
[*]fixed Lord Zetar script (one block of text was missing due to the bug in the script)
[*]fixed voiceover replay bug
[*]fixed material tile for danian temples that had incorrect texture (materials\lod\temple\danian_a\danian_temple_cc.dds)
[*]fixed material (materials\lod\miscellaneous\grave\dirt_grave.material) with wrong texture
[*]fixed material (materials\lod\foliage\replace\cat.material) with missing texture
[*]fixed bug in the maps panel where merchants had empty tooltip
[*]fixed bug in the maps panel where game sometimes crashed when you ran it on your bosses computer with Windows 10 OS


[h1]Voices of Narr[/h1]

Our last big step towards having the complete product is adding voice overs, and the biggest news around this is that the voiceovers are recorded and ready in the new patch! The new big patch on Steam includes voices for over 30 major characters in the game. 

Most of the actors were working on some major game blockbusters and we had to wait a bit.
We are thankful that they found time for an indie developer during this busiest period.
We’d like to use this opportunity to present you the great voice actors who "made" WoD characters come to life.

[list]
[*]Lani Minella
[*]Tim Simmons
[*]Stephen Fitts aka StephanosRex
[*]Dylan Jones
[*]Jim Barrish aka CRPGNUT
[/list]

We would also like to mention the incredible community at RPGWatch who helped us with suggestions and ideas for our RPG title, as well as being awesome and friendly towards our community manager, Iggy. But, not only that. One of the members of RPGWatch community, Jim Barrish, better known as CRPGNUT offered to generously help us with his voice overs for the future tutorials or game characters. 
It is an absolute pleasure to do this work when the community joins hands with the developer in creating a better game.

[h1]Getting released is NOT "that's it folks, we are done here"[/h1]

The release for us simply means that we are now declaring Wave of Darkness a complete rounded product. It isn’t perfect, with every patch released our wish list grows even further. As more and more gamers join our community, we are sure that there will be an abundance of great new suggestions (and hopefully a very few bug reports) which will ensure continued post release development for a long and exciting time. 

You will continue to receive updates with the same frequency as during the Early Access development stage, we will continue talking with you on Kickstarter and Steam discussion boards, and we will continue listening to your ideas and suggestions. 

[h1]What are the next steps?[/h1]

With the full Wave of Darkness release getting closer by the day, we have another big promise to keep; we have to start working on physical rewards for our Kickstarter backers.

We would also like to expand the Wave of Darkness community as much as possible. As you most probably know, for an indie developer without the marketing budget it is quite challenging to break through to relevant media. 
Most of the gaming web pages so far told us they will wait for the final release as they (usually) do not review titles in Early Access. Also, many gamers tend to avoid Early Access titles, and even if they don’t, our visibility on the Steam is pretty low right now.

Not only that, but being too long in Early Access can be counterproductive: Some titles on Steam are for "eons" in Early Access, but we don't want that. We have rounded up all the features we want in the game and integrated them.

We invite you to join our efforts once again, at the most important moment during this final stage, with the best vibe that you can help us create. Each and every new WoD player will contribute to the momentum which will in turn enable us to do amazing things for the game with future updates.

Please spread the word about the Wave of Darkness and be a regular visitor at the community hub.
Thank you Kickstarter backers, Paypal supporters and Early Access community for your involvement.

Your,

Dreamatrix Team

[h1]Now, about that massive new Wave of Darkness update. Here is what you will get:[/h1]

[list]
[*]added intro video
[*]added bunch of tooltips for character generation panels, character info panel, inventory, spellbook, maps panel, legendary items panel and quest log panel
[*]minimum number of inventory slots increased from 14 to 42 (see, we do listen to your suggestions ;-)

[*]added voiceover files for:
[list]
[*]Taras Ras Balinos (ship captain on docks)
[*]herbalist (on docks)
[*]Ubar Nevera (defense commander)
[*]Alitea Nevera (leader of rangers)
[*]Casir Ras Dianos (herbalist on south entrance to the city)
[*]Xocutus (blind librarian)
[*]Silvana Vordar (Xocutus' happy helper)
[*]Nilara Vordar (Nils' grand-grand-grand-...-grand-daughter)
[*]Llorena (Disciple of Veles priestess)
[*]Vinkl Minkel (opportunistic weapons dealer from Legends of Dawn)
[*]Lord Darius Nevera
[*]Lady Selina Vordar
[*]Baba Yarra (crazy old lady with chickens)
[*]Elniren (ranger)
[*]Sorin Amas Darelin (herbalist)
[*]Arun Bis Lorenar (soldier)
[*]Darien Palar (merchant from Cesanaar)
[*]Garo (caretaker's son)
[*]Smragor the Mighty (caretaker of Temple of Time)
[*]Telnir (cursed caretaker)
[*]Sileran Dain Vaturas (wizard in Mirna's house)
[*]Barnir (Lamar's brother, hermit)
[*]Lamar (priest in Nam Yorath)
[*]Lord Aturil Zetar (exiled leader)
[*]Theral Zetar (lord Zetar's son)
[*]Grummharal (ancient hero merged with Bezharal)
[*]Ralan (fisherman in village on the edge of desert)
[*]Morodok the Evil Shaman
[*]Tka'r (only rizar in the game)
[*]Saradok (leader of Snake Cult)
[*]Zoug (monster in castle brown-skull)
[/list]

[*]fixed bug with game crashing on alt+tab while in character generator or main menu
[*]fixed/changed/updated tons of NPC conversation texts (mostly changes regarding grammar, and some slight changes regarding quest objectives)
[*]fixed item generation bug when creating new characters (one where it was possible to get items such as weapons and armor with too high requirements, you were able to de-equip those items but were unable to equip them again)
[*]fixed 'Smash and Run' quest description in quest log panel
[*]fixed 'Dark Sisters' quest description in quest log panel
[*]fixed Lord Zetar script (one block of text was missing due to the bug in the script)
[*]fixed voiceover replay bug
[*]fixed material tile for danian temples that had incorrect texture (materials\lod\temple\danian_a\danian_temple_cc.dds)
[*]fixed material (materials\lod\miscellaneous\grave\dirt_grave.material) with wrong texture
[*]fixed material (materials\lod\foliage\replace\cat.material) with missing texture
[*]fixed bug in the maps panel where merchants had empty tooltip
[*]fixed bug in the maps panel where game sometimes crashed when you ran it on your bosses computer with Windows 10 OS


[h1]Voices of Narr[/h1]

Our last big step towards having the complete product is adding voice overs, and the biggest news around this is that the voiceovers are recorded and ready in the new patch! The new big patch on Steam includes voices for over 30 major characters in the game. 

Most of the actors were working on some major game blockbusters and we had to wait a bit.
We are thankful that they found time for an indie developer during this busiest period.
We’d like to use this opportunity to present you the great voice actors who "made" WoD characters come to life.

[list]
[*]Lani Minella
[*]Tim Simmons
[*]Stephen Fitts aka StephanosRex
[*]Dylan Jones
[*]Jim Barrish aka CRPGNUT
[/list]

We would also like to mention the incredible community at RPGWatch who helped us with suggestions and ideas for our RPG title, as well as being awesome and friendly towards our community manager, Iggy. But, not only that. One of the members of RPGWatch community, Jim Barrish, better known as CRPGNUT offered to generously help us with his voice overs for the future tutorials or game characters. 
It is an absolute pleasure to do this work when the community joins hands with the developer in creating a better game.

[h1]Getting released is NOT "that's it folks, we are done here"[/h1]

The release for us simply means that we are now declaring Wave of Darkness a complete rounded product. It isn’t perfect, with every patch released our wish list grows even further. As more and more gamers join our community, we are sure that there will be an abundance of great new suggestions (and hopefully a very few bug reports) which will ensure continued post release development for a long and exciting time. 

You will continue to receive updates with the same frequency as during the Early Access development stage, we will continue talking with you on Kickstarter and Steam discussion boards, and we will continue listening to your ideas and suggestions. 

[h1]What are the next steps?[/h1]

With the full Wave of Darkness release getting closer by the day, we have another big promise to keep; we have to start working on physical rewards for our Kickstarter backers.

We would also like to expand the Wave of Darkness community as much as possible. As you most probably know, for an indie developer without the marketing budget it is quite challenging to break through to relevant media. 
Most of the gaming web pages so far told us they will wait for the final release as they (usually) do not review titles in Early Access. Also, many gamers tend to avoid Early Access titles, and even if they don’t, our visibility on the Steam is pretty low right now.

Not only that, but being too long in Early Access can be counterproductive: Some titles on Steam are for "eons" in Early Access, but we don't want that. We have rounded up all the features we want in the game and integrated them.

We invite you to join our efforts once again, at the most important moment during this final stage, with the best vibe that you can help us create. Each and every new WoD player will contribute to the momentum which will in turn enable us to do amazing things for the game with future updates.

Please spread the word about the Wave of Darkness and be a regular visitor at the community hub.
Thank you Kickstarter backers, Paypal supporters and Early Access community for your involvement.

Your,

Dreamatrix Team

notes.title: Wave of Darkness Patch 1.30 is now LIVE!
notes.content:
Hi all!

Major things are hapenning for Wave of Darkness again because we have published another exciting patch! Here is what has been changed and what you will get:

[list]
[*]We have upgraded how skills work. Now you gain additional bonuses when you develop skills to certain level (5/10/15/20). All old skill bonuses still work as before so you can play with your regular saved games. These bonuses are added to all skills except for Gathering skills (only two of them - mining and lumbering).

[*]We have fixed several bugs, most noticeable wrong rendering of fog of war in Maps panel (it could  be replicated when you set map to be show at 1/3 scree resolution). Maps panel should now display all types of icons at start. You do not have to manually activate them each time you play. Also, display of NPCs and monsters markers in the minimap (top left corner of the screen) is fixed.

[*]Bug with text not being correctly displayed in some panels is (hopefully) fixed. Panels in questions were Load Game, Save Game, Shop, Quest Log and Bestiary.
[/list]

Also, for those interested in skills, you can find a list of current bonuses added in this update at discussion forum.

notes.title: Wave of Darkness Patch 1.11
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We are continuing to bring more fixes and updates to Wave of Darkness, so the latest patch is here!

Check the changelog below!

[h1]Wave of Darkness Patch 1.11[/h1]

[b]Wave of Darkness Patch 1.11 is now live.[/b]

[list]
[*]Standing creatures corpses and frozen monsters

The game had a nasty bug with animations not being played on dead creatures during the saved game loading. Now those animations are played correctly, although this should be tested some more.
Also, it is very likely that this issue is connected to bug that sometimes occurs when player kills the monster and death animation is not played so that monster stays frozen in place. This bug is visual bug only - it has no other impact on the game, but it is annoying. Game should be tested some more to see if the fix removed death animation bug also.

We have spent a lot of time fixing this bug, so that's why this patch doesn't bring more fixes and upgrades as the previous one.

[*]Door animation bug

Doors on the location [945,751] had visual bug. Door worked fine but were rendered incorrectly. This has been fixed.

[*]Young Deepcave Storm Tormentor bug

This creature at location [1216,1273] was not supposed to be here. Tormentor spider was testing spider used during quest scripting. We have deleted all of them except this one. Instead of Tormentor, there should be Venomous Spider at this location. This has been fixed.

[*]Invisible Spirit bug

Invisible Spirit had wrong name for aura effect. It should be "Horror" instead of standard debug ~missing~. This has been fixed.
[/list]


As always, stay up-to-date with our work on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/316370/discussions/]Discussion Boards[/url], give us more [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/316370/discussions/0/598198173699356534/]suggestions[/url] about what would you like to see in the game, and of course, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/316370/discussions/0/598198173699343906/]report new issues[/url]!

Thank you!

Yours,
Dreamatrix Team

notes.title: Wave of Darkness Patch 1.10
notes.content:
Hey all! As you can see, we keep patching the game on a regular basis, and the changelog can be seen below:

[h1]Wave of Darkness Patch 1.10[/h1]

[list]
[*]Music combat and transition/fadeout fixes

We have changed time needed for music fadeouts. It was too short and music change was too abrupt. Change from full volume to zero volume lasted approximately 1 second. This is now increased to approximately 10 seconds. Hopefully it will be enough.

[*]Cursed item notifications

We have added notification icons for cursed items. When you have equipped cursed item, skull icon will be displayed beneath player's name and level (similar to icons representing spell effects). Placing mouse over skull icon will show you which item is cursed and what you have to do to remove the curse (identify at oracle stones and/or then pray at god shrine).

[*]Map zoom changed

Map zoom was slightly off when zooming on 1/3 screen sized map. This has been fixed. Maps panel should now work fine no matter what the size of the map window is.

[*]Map 'Size' button

We added 'Size' button to Maps panel. Clicking on it will toggle panel size between (almost) fullscreen size and 1/3 screen size panel.

[*]Map icons upgraded

We have slightly changed some icons. Few of them had low contrast in regard to background. This has been fixed.

[*]Additional map locations #1

We have added fishing places and danian tomb locations to the maps panel.

[*]Additional map locations #2

We have added 'singing stones' locations to the maps panel.

[*]Intro text corrections

We have changed intro text. Thanks to Kepi al-Duri for this one.
[/list]

Once again, we would like to mention that [url=http://www.dreamatrix.net/news/wod_updates.html]on this link[/url] you can see what are we currently working on and what fixes you can expect in the future!

Thank you for your support!

Yours,
Dreamatrix Team

Placing mouse over skull icon will show you which item is cursed and what you have to do to remove the curse (identify at oracle stones and/or then pray at god shrine).

tags.bug: Map zoom was slightly off when zooming on 1/3 screen sized map. This has been fixed. Maps panel should now work fine no matter what the size of the map window is.

tags.feature: We added 'Size' button to Maps panel. Clicking on it will toggle panel size between (almost) fullscreen size and 1/3 screen size panel.

tags.bug: We have slightly changed some icons. Few of them had low contrast in regard to background. This has been fixed.

tags.feature: We have added fishing places and danian tomb locations to the maps panel.
We have added 'singing stones' locations to the maps panel.

tags.bug: We have changed intro text. Thanks to Kepi al-Duri for this one.

notes.title: Wave of Darkness patch 1.06 - The New Map
notes.content:
Hi all,

The new patch 1.06 is out, along with the new map 

We have updated maps panel. Previous Maps panel had serious problems. One of our primary concerns when creating GUI was that each and every GUI panel must fit into minimal supported resolution for the game - which is 1024x768 pixels. That means no panel can be higher than ~700 pixels. This is all fine but most players today play at 1680x1050 of HD resolutions which means they have extra space and no panel uses it. Smaller panels are not a problem for most of the time. Characters panel, or Legendary Items panel never need extra size, but maps panel could really benefit from being bigger.
So we started brainstorming.

First thing we decided was to expand maps panel to fit almost entire screen. This gave us much needed space. Game will always rescale the maps panel to fit almost entire screen (there will be 25 pixels on all sizes around the Maps panel window but that's it). In addition to that, we cut extra space at the top of the Maps panel which gave us almost 100 pixels.
Coordinates label at the bottom, region title, X button and other panel components will be placed on their positions depending which resolution you use.
So now map area is much larger. One thing to note is that, since map area is larger, background map image is blurrier. Previous map image had 2048x2048 resolution. New image has 4096x4096 resolution. If your graphics card does not support 4096x4096 textures, it will be scaled to fit the maximum supported size for your card.
In addition, we decided to remove zoom in/zoom out buttons. They were ok for the previous map, but they are seriously lacking for upgraded one. At the bottom of the maps panel, there is new zoom slider. You can use it to zoom in and out much more easily than before.

Previous Maps panel had checkboxes with various location types such as entrances to dungeons or locations of god shrines or other points of interest. We have removed those checkboxes since they took large amount of screen space. In order to toggle display of various maps components you can use new Filter button at the bottom of the screen. Clicking on it will activate popup window with various filters available. You can toggle on and off each filter entry as you wish. Default state is that everything will be displayed.

We have added new icons and new location types to the Maps panel. From version 1.06 forward you will be able to see all previous locations including new ones: wells, campfires, signposts, metal ores, plants, oracles, respawn points, teleport stones and legendary items. We are working on adding even more locations. Reason for long wait between 1.05 and 1.06 is mostly that we had to rewrite large part of this panel which included both code change and graphics change.

We are aware that some features are still missing. The button to center the player and the mouse wheel capability to zoom the map in and out are coming in the next patch. Those are not implemented yet.

List of other improvements:

- Lord Nevera problem
Lord Nevera had faulti script while in the Lost bay region. It is now fixed. Quest 'Wind, Blood and High Seas' should end when player talks to Lord Nevera and 'Rising Tide' quest should start after the Nevera is defeated.
Note: if you have savegame near the Lord Nevera, it may be neccessary to move few screens back so that scripts are refreshed and Nevera respawns with new script attached to him.

- Caretaker of Change notification
'Caretaker of Change' quest requires that player finds caretaker's house and brings Caretaker's notes back to Xocutus. When clicking on caretaker's body, standard chest/itemholder panel was opened. This has been changed so that clicking on caretaker's body activates tooltip with hint.

- Problem with Mouse Cursor
Few people had problem with mouse cursor. Game uses colorized mouse cursors which are changed depending on player's actions. However, on some configurations there is a problem where players are unable to move mouse cursor at all.

Possible workaround for this problem is to edit config\game_lod.config.txt file and change this line:

use_hardware_mouse_cursor: 0

Setting this value to zero will disable colorized mouse cursor and use default window mouse cursor. We have reports this fixed the problem for most of the players with this bug.
At this time we are not sure what is the cause of this issue. We suspect it's a driver problem or some such but we are unable to reproduce this bug at this time. Wave of Darkness runs on multiple systems (Windows XP/Vista/7/8/8.1/10) and it's very hard to check all the combinations of hardware, software and drivers. Obviously some configurations don't like hardware mouse cursor change but unfortunately we cannot seem to reproduce this issue on our machines. We'll notify you if we manage to reproduce and/or completely fix this bug.

- Stairs and Navigation
We have changed way the navigation on stairs works. It's still not perfect but navigation over them should be better than before.

- Windowed mode for localization
"It is necessary windowed mode. This will allow the streamer to do translation and overview videos much easier."

We have added option to start the game in windowed mode. However this option is not for regular playing, just to be used during translation/localization process. In order to activate it, you will have to add following line in the config\game_lod.config.txt file:

allow_windowed_mode: 1

When this option is activated and you start the game, you will be asked whether you wish to run the game in fullscreen or windowed mode.

- News button
News button activated Legends of Dawn news download and not Wave of Darkness download. This has been fixed.

- Unused button crash
